schedule.label: major lien fund: retention/safe-payment date
schedule.basis: 10% retained for 60 days from the certificate of substantial performance; payment may validly be made after that if no lien is registered

schedule.label: minor lien fund: retention/safe-payment date
schedule.basis: 10% of post-certificate work retained for 60 days from completion

schedule.label: annual/phased holdback payment
schedule.basis: an owner MUST pay holdback early only if the contract provides annual/phased payment, the price exceeds $10,000,000, and no liens are filed - not computed

schedule.label: holdback to retain (amount, not a date)
schedule.basis: CAD 125,000.50 x 10% = CAD 12,500.05 retained. The statute applies the rate to the value of the work actually done; you chose the base (check with your accountant or lawyer whether tax is in it). Rounded half-up to the cent (the rounding rule is not stated in the text we read - unverified).

disclaimer: Administrative reminder, not legal advice - verify with counsel.
applicability: Alberta government (Public Works Act) contracts are outside the PPCLA payment timelines (alberta.ca prompt-payment page).
Contracts that pre-date the Aug 29, 2022 start of the new rules may follow the old Act (alberta.ca prompt-payment page).
